g.text: One Rust module, band1t, on Maincloud: 72 tables, 86 reducers, 54 views and 5 timers. A reducer is a function that runs as one transaction. Timers run reducers on a
schedule. Every screen subscribes to views, so each change reaches it as soon as it commits.
reducer: writes the band row: state, zone, last seen
opens an sos or fall incident and records the light
circle as witnesses in incident_band, in one
reducer, ops or medic: queues the band's clear command
marks bands, stations and the gateway
offline after 5 s without a message
moves the crowd from start_crowd: up to
puts a job back in the queue when its 60
each caller gets only their rows: my_band, my_visits, my_encounters, my_wallet; medic_medical_cards: the cards this medic tapped; claims_board:
staff only; worker_jobs: workers only; event_graph: one shared result with no names
only the owner can grant_role: ops,
most once a second per band
